beasiswa_status_check.name: beasiswa_status_check
beasiswa_status_check.value:
("beasiswa"."status" = 'draf' AND "beasiswa"."diperiksa_oleh" IS NULL AND "beasiswa"."diperiksa_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("beasiswa"."status" <> 'draf' AND "beasiswa"."diperiksa_at" IS NOT NULL AND "beasiswa"."diperiksa_oleh" <> "beasiswa"."dimasukkan_oleh")

beasiswa_ditarik_check.name: beasiswa_ditarik_check
beasiswa_ditarik_check.value:
("beasiswa"."status" = 'ditarik') = ("beasiswa"."ditarik_at" IS NOT NULL AND "beasiswa"."alasan_ditarik" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("beasiswa"."status" = 'ditarik' OR ("beasiswa"."ditarik_at" IS NULL AND "beasiswa"."alasan_ditarik" IS NULL))

info_biaya_jumlah_check.name: info_biaya_jumlah_check
info_biaya_jumlah_check.value:
("info_biaya"."biaya_semester" IS NULL OR "info_biaya"."biaya_semester" BETWEEN 0 AND 50000000)
        AND ("info_biaya"."uang_pangkal" IS NULL OR "info_biaya"."uang_pangkal" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000)
        AND ("info_biaya"."biaya_lain_masuk" IS NULL OR "info_biaya"."biaya_lain_masuk" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000)
        AND ("info_biaya"."kelompok_ukt" IS NULL OR "info_biaya"."kelompok_ukt" BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
